messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@clearsighthealth.com>, Elena Morris <elena.morris@clearsighthealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Prelaunch visibility sprint cadence — ClearSight Health telemetry

Hi Samir / Elena,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our discussion I’m sending the proposed prelaunch visibility plan so we can align on owners, the sprint cadence, and the initial deliverables for dashboards, tracing hooks, and alert routing. Attached is the scope workbook we used in the call (clearsight-telemetry-scope.xlsx).

High-level asks from Redwood:
- Confirm target services (we captured 6: ingestion-api, inference-gateway, request-router, cache-layer, auth, batch-processor).
- Identify incident owner(s) on your side for P1/P2/P3 mapping.
- Approve a 2-week sprint cadence for implementation (detailed schedule below).

Proposed 2-week sprint cadence (prelaunch):
Week 0 (this week): kickoff, scope sign-off, runbook template handoff
Week 1: instrumentation + tracing hooks (low-latency paths)
Week 2: dashboard wireframes + alert taxonomy draft
Week 3: runbook population + routing rules QA
Week 4: smoke run and go/no-go checklist

Next steps: Can you confirm owners and whether a 2-week cadence works? If yes I’ll share a short runbook template and a visibility checklist.

Best,
Connor
Connor O'Brien | Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0142

Attachment: clearsight-telemetry-scope.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@clearsighthealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@clearsighthealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prelaunch visibility sprint cadence — ClearSight Health telemetry

Thanks Connor — this looks good. Two quick clarifications:
1) Runbook template: can you include a sample incident postmortem section and the mapping we should use to our PagerDuty escalation?
2) Alert taxonomy: our SRE wants thresholds expressed as both absolute and % change where applicable.

Owners here:
- P1/P0 incidents: Elena Morris (Head of SRE)
- App-level engineering owner: Samir Gupta (Platform)

2-week cadence is fine. We’d like the tracing hook names to follow our existing naming convention: cs.<service>.<handler>.<span>. If Redwood has a recommended minimal set we can map.

Also requesting the runbook and checklist to be in Markdown (we version them in our repo).

Samir
Samir Gupta | Platform Lead | ClearSight Health
Phone: +1-617-555-0199
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@clearsighthealth.com>, Elena Morris <elena.morris@clearsighthealth.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-02T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prelaunch visibility sprint cadence — ClearSight Health telemetry

Samir —

Thanks for the owners and the tracing naming guidance; that helps. I’ve attached a runbook template (runbook-template-v2.md) and a short checklist PDF (visibility-prelaunch-checklist.pdf). The runbook V2 includes:
- Incident page template (symptoms, impact, mitigation, RCA)
- PagerDuty mapping example (we’ll add your escalation IDs during implementation)
- Playbook section for data-retention considerations (relevant for SOC/audit)

For tracing hooks, our recommended minimal set:
- entry span (cs.<service>.entry)
- db/cache call spans (cs.<service>.db.query, cs.<service>.cache.get)
- external call spans (cs.<service>.http.outbound)
- inference tokenization + model call spans (cs.<service>.model.request)

Alert taxonomy: we’ll draft thresholds in both absolute and relative terms and include sample Prometheus alert rules for you. Expect the first draft by Tuesday (2026-08-04).

Laura
Laura Bennett | Implementation Lead, Observability | Redwood Inference

Attachments: runbook-template-v2.md (markdown), visibility-prelaunch-checklist.pdf (PDF, 35KB)

Subject: Internal: ClearSight prelaunch — owners & timeline

Quick internal note so we’re aligned before the Tuesday deliverable:
- Owner mapping: Laura (instrumentation + tracing), Ben (dashboards + Grafana panels), Connor (customer liaison + scheduling), Marissa (routing rules + runbook QA).
- Timeline: Laura to share draft alert taxonomy by 2026-08-04 10:00 PT; Ben will have initial dashboard wireframes by 2026-08-06.
- Risk flags: their batch-processor has intermittent latency spikes during load tests — prioritize an alert for 95th percentile tail latency on that service.

I’ll validate PagerDuty IDs with Samir on Tuesday morning; Connor can confirm runbook hosting preference (repo v. Confluence).

Marissa

  • Customer incident owner: Elena (P1/P2), Samir (engineering lead).
- Hosting: Samir prefers Markdown in their repo; we’ll push the runbook template to their GitHub and also attach a Confluence mirror for our internal tracking.

Connor
